topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't stop thinking about what you told me. It’s like, one minute everything’s fine, and the next, I’m questioning everything. You deserve so much better than this, and finding out about the job just throws everything into a loop. I mean, it’s not like I don’t get why someone might do that, feeling pressured or whatever. But it’s you, and it’s just, I don’t know. It feels like this could change things, and I wish it didn’t. I hope we can talk this through, find a way to make sense of it all. You’re important to me, and I don’t want this to mess us up.
